title: Assessing the Impact of Restricting Skilled and Unskilled Migration: A General Equilibrium Approach
title_zh: 评估限制技能与非技能移民的影响：一般均衡方法
title_primary: 评估限制技能与非技能移民的影响：一般均衡方法
title_secondary: Assessing the Impact of Restricting Skilled and Unskilled Migration: A General Equilibrium Approach
authors: Ms. Alina Carare & Metodij Hadzi-Vaskov & Jessie Kilembe & Felipe Leal
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We augment the two-country DSGE model from Mandelman and Zlate (2012) with endogenous migration of both skilled and unskilled labor, and analyze the economic impact of restricting migration for each type of labor on the migrants’ source and host countries. We calibrate the model with data for Guatemala and the U.S. as the source and host countries respectively. Restricting unskilled immigration has a more severe contractionary impact on the host economy than restricting skilled migration—reducing aggregate output by approximately 1 percent and consumption by 0.6 percent compared to the steady state—, given that in the steady state a lot more unskilled migrants are needed in the production function. Restricting unskilled immigration impacts negatively skilled immigration flows, but not vice versa, and it has a significant overall impact on the source economy, with aggregate consumption and income declining (mostly due to a fall in remittances). Our findings also highlight a key policy trade-off for the host economy: while a restrictive immigration policy (especially for unskilled labor) could reduce wage inequality by compressing the skill premium—raising host-country unskilled wages by 8 percent while lowering skilled wages by 1 percent compared to the steady state—, and could increase output per capita, it comes at the cost of lower overall economic activity and aggregate consumption. Moreover, by increasing the wage gap for unskilled labor between host and source economies, it also raises incentives for immigration, despite the increased cost of migration.
abstract_zh: 我们在Mandelman和Zlate（2012）的双国DSGE模型中加入了技能与非技能劳动力的内生迁移，并分析了限制各类劳动力迁移对移民来源国和东道国经济的影响。我们利用危地马拉和美国分别作为来源国和东道国的数据对模型进行了校准。限制非技能移民对东道国经济的紧缩效应比限制技能迁移更为严重——与稳态相比，总产出减少约1%，消费减少0.6%——这是因为在稳态下，生产函数中需要更多的非技能移民。限制非技能移民对技能移民流动产生负面影响，但反之则不然，并且对来源国经济具有显著的整体影响，总消费和收入下降（主要归因于汇款减少）。我们的研究结果还凸显了东道国面临的一个关键政策权衡：虽然限制性移民政策（尤其是针对非技能劳动力）可能通过压缩技能溢价来降低工资不平等——与稳态相比，东道国非技能工资上升8%，而技能工资下降1%——并可能提高人均产出，但这是以降低整体经济活动和总消费为代价的。此外，通过扩大东道国与来源国之间非技能劳动力的工资差距，该政策也增加了移民的激励，尽管移民成本有所上升。

title: Gender Reveals in the Labor Market
title_zh: 劳动力市场中的性别揭示
title_primary: 劳动力市场中的性别揭示
title_secondary: Gender Reveals in the Labor Market
authors: Haoran He, David Neumark, Qian Weng
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study gender discrimination in an online health care market. Statistical discrimination implies that the impact of gender on prices should decline, and the impact of reviews increase, as reviews accumulate. However, in our context these implications do not hold, because doctors choose how strongly to signal gender. We develop a new test for the implications of statistical discrimination based on this choice. We find evidence consistent with statistical discrimination against female doctors in male-dominated fields, and vice versa. For example, female doctors mask gender more strongly initially in male-dominated fields, and the gender gap in signaling declines as reviews accumulate.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在线医疗市场中的性别歧视。统计歧视理论表明，随着评论的积累，性别对价格的影响应减弱，而评论的影响应增强。然而，在我们的情境中，这些推论并不成立，因为医生会选择如何强烈地传达性别信号。我们基于这一选择开发了一种新的检验统计歧视推论的方法。我们发现证据与统计歧视一致，即在男性主导领域中针对女性医生存在歧视，反之亦然。例如，在男性主导领域中，女性医生最初更强烈地隐藏性别，而随着评论的积累，性别信号差距逐渐缩小。

title: Taxing polluting resources: growth, welfare and consumption inequality
title_zh: 对污染性资源征税：增长、福利与消费不平等
title_primary: 对污染性资源征税：增长、福利与消费不平等
title_secondary: Taxing polluting resources: growth, welfare and consumption inequality
authors: Ken Tabata
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a Romer (1990)‐type endogenous growth model that incorporates polluting non‐renewable resources and heterogeneous households with varying asset holdings. It contributes to the literature on the taxation of polluting exhaustible resources by examining its impact on consumption inequality, with particular emphasis on the role of natural resources as household assets. In the model, the stock of pollution—accumulating through resource use—affects social welfare. We show that, when distortions from intertemporal knowledge spillovers are not fully corrected, environmental tax policies that slow resource extraction and mitigate the welfare costs of pollution can foster economic growth but exacerbate consumption inequality. To promote growth and reduce the welfare damage caused by pollution without increasing inequality, environmental tax revenues should be allocated for redistributive purposes. Lastly, the paper calibrates the model for quantitative analysis and explores environmental tax policies that maximize social welfare under limited government capacity to correct knowledge spillover distortions, relying on environmental tax revenues for redistribution.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个罗默（1990）式内生增长模型，该模型融入了污染性不可再生资源及资产持有量各异的异质性家庭。本文对污染性可耗竭资源税收研究领域的贡献在于，考察了此类税收对消费不平等的影响，特别强调了自然资源作为家庭资产的作用。在模型中，通过资源使用累积的污染存量影响社会福利。我们证明，当跨期知识溢出的扭曲未被完全纠正时，减缓资源开采并减轻污染福利成本的环境税收政策虽能促进经济增长，却会加剧消费不平等。为在不加剧不平等的前提下促进增长并减少污染造成的福利损害，环境税收收入应被用于再分配目的。最后，本文对模型进行了校准以进行定量分析，并探讨了在政府纠正知识溢出扭曲能力有限、依赖环境税收收入进行再分配的情况下，能够最大化社会福利的环境税收政策。

title: Virtual Tutoring with Computer-Assisted Learning: An Experiment in Take-Up and Learning
title_zh: 计算机辅助学习下的虚拟辅导：一项关于参与度与学习效果的实验
title_primary: 计算机辅助学习下的虚拟辅导：一项关于参与度与学习效果的实验
title_secondary: Virtual Tutoring with Computer-Assisted Learning: An Experiment in Take-Up and Learning
authors: Philip Oreopoulos, Ruochong Dong, Nina Low
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We explore the efficacy of an online after-school tutoring program that complements teacher-provided computer-assisted learning practice. The aim is to scaffold students struggling with online Khan Academy practice at school with low-cost, one-on-one virtual supervision for about an hour a week at home. In a two-year randomized trial with the Toronto District School Board, teachers identified struggling Grade 4–8 students, whose parents were then randomly offered additional online tutoring to support their practice at home. The main obstacle was participation. Only 45% of assigned students reached a first session in Year 1. After we reframed the invitation and simplified enrollment, initial take-up in Year 2 rose to 83%, though weekly attendance remained below half—not because students dropped out, but because they attended intermittently. On average, the offer raised Khan Academy practice by about 10 minutes per week. This translated to an average gain in math assessment scores of 0.06 SD, with a confidence interval too wide to rule out null or medium-sized gains (ITT 0.055 SD; 95% CI [−0.09, 0.20]). We find a marginally significant gain in math report-card marks (about 0.08 SD; 95% CI [−0.01, 0.17]) and improvements in math satisfaction and enjoyment, with effects larger in Year 2 than in Year 1, consistent with the higher take-up that year. We therefore conclude that the program holds promise, but more is needed to ensure students actually engage with tutors on a regular basis.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了一项在线课后辅导项目的有效性，该项目补充了教师提供的计算机辅助学习练习。其目标是为在校内进行可汗学院在线练习时遇到困难的学生，提供每周约一小时、低成本的一对一虚拟监督，以支持他们在家的学习。在与多伦多地区教育局进行的一项为期两年的随机试验中，教师识别出4至8年级中学习困难的学生，随后随机向这些学生的家长提供额外的在线辅导，以支持他们在家的练习。主要障碍在于参与度。第一年，仅有45%被分配的学生参加了首次辅导。在重新调整邀请方式并简化注册流程后，第二年的初始参与率上升至83%，但每周出勤率仍低于一半——这并非因为学生退出，而是因为他们间歇性参与。平均而言，该辅导提议使可汗学院练习时间每周增加了约10分钟。这转化为数学评估成绩平均提高0.06个标准差，但置信区间过宽，无法排除零效应或中等效应（意向治疗分析效应为0.055个标准差；95%置信区间[-0.09, 0.20]）。我们发现数学成绩单分数有边际显著提高（约0.08个标准差；95%置信区间[-0.01, 0.17]），以及数学满意度和享受度的改善，且第二年的效应大于第一年，这与当年更高的参与率一致。因此，我们得出结论，该项目具有潜力，但还需更多努力以确保学生定期与辅导教师互动。

title: Personal Bankruptcy Protection and Household Debt
title_zh: 个人破产保护与家庭债务
title_primary: 个人破产保护与家庭债务
title_secondary: Personal Bankruptcy Protection and Household Debt
authors: Felipe Severino, Meta Brown, Rajashri Chakrabarti
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Increasing personal bankruptcy protection raises consumers’ desire to borrow and lenders’ cost of extending credit; the impact on equilibrium borrowing is ambiguous. Using bankruptcy protection changes between 1999 and 2005 across U.S. states, we find that borrowers respond to greater protection by increasing their unsecured debt. Border county estimates suggest that local economic conditions do not drive these results. Borrowers pay more for protection through higher interest rates, yet delinquency is unaffected. Our results indicate that rising borrower demand outstripped decreasing supply. Increased protections did not reduce the aggregate level of household debt but affected the composition of borrowing. (JEL G00, G33, G51, D14, D18, K35, R2)
abstract_zh: 提高个人破产保护会增加消费者的借贷意愿和贷款方的信贷成本；这对均衡借贷的影响是不确定的。利用1999年至2005年间美国各州破产保护的变化，我们发现借款人对更强的保护作出反应，增加了其无担保债务。边界县估计表明，当地经济状况并非这些结果的驱动因素。借款人通过更高的利率为保护支付更多，但违约率并未受到影响。我们的结果表明，上升的借款人需求超过了下降的供给。增强的保护并未减少家庭债务的总体水平，但影响了借贷的构成。（JEL G00, G33, G51, D14, D18, K35, R2）

title: Government Policy, Low‐ and High‐Skilled Labour, and Technical Inefficiency in Chinese Agriculture, 1952–2008
title_zh: 中国政府政策、高低技能劳动力与中国农业技术效率（1952—2008）
title_primary: 中国政府政策、高低技能劳动力与中国农业技术效率（1952—2008）
title_secondary: Government Policy, Low‐ and High‐Skilled Labour, and Technical Inefficiency in Chinese Agriculture, 1952–2008
authors: Yulong Chen, Peter F. Orazem
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We utilize Chinese provincial data to explore how government policies affected grain production between 1952 and 2008. We adapt the Caselli‐Coleman framework to allow multiple inputs including fertilizer, land and capital as well as skilled and unskilled labour. We also extend the method to allow for comparisons of production possibilities over time as well as across provinces. We derive measures of the technological frontier for Chinese agricultural production for each year over the 56‐year period. The empirical estimates illustrate how labour efficiency in Chinese grain production changed from 1952 to 2008, encompassing the Great Leap Forward (1958–1962), the collective farming period (1963–1977), and the rural economic reforms initiated in 1978. Government policies held back agricultural production in the 1960s and 1970s by limiting efficient use of labour at a time when the Green Revolution was raising grain yields dramatically throughout Asia. Reductions in labour efficiency led to a 12.9% average decline in grain output during the Great Leap Forward and little gain during the collective farming period. In contrast, rural reforms that allowed farmers to profit from production above their assigned quotas starting in 1978 significantly enhanced labour efficiency for the more skilled but had little impact on the productive efficiency of unskilled agricultural workers.
abstract_zh: 我们利用中国省级数据，探讨了1952年至2008年间政府政策如何影响粮食生产。我们调整了卡塞利-科尔曼框架，以纳入包括化肥、土地和资本以及熟练与非熟练劳动力在内的多种投入要素。同时，我们扩展了该方法，以便在时间维度和省份间进行生产可能性比较。我们推导出了这56年间中国农业生产技术前沿的度量指标。实证估计展示了1952年至2008年间中国粮食生产中劳动力效率的变化，涵盖了“大跃进”时期（1958-1962年）、集体耕作时期（1963-1977年）以及1978年启动的农村经济改革。政府政策在20世纪60年代和70年代限制了劳动力的有效利用，而此时绿色革命正大幅提高整个亚洲的粮食产量，从而阻碍了农业生产。劳动力效率的下降导致“大跃进”期间粮食产量平均下降12.9%，而在集体耕作时期增长甚微。相比之下，自1978年起允许农民从超出分配定额的生产中获利的农村改革，显著提升了技能较高劳动力的效率，但对非熟练农业工人的生产效率影响甚微。

title: Who is Afraid of Eurobonds?
title_zh: 谁害怕欧元债券？
title_primary: 谁害怕欧元债券？
title_secondary: Who is Afraid of Eurobonds?
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Qingyuan Fang, Leonardo Melosi, Anna Rogantini Picco
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The current euro area policy framework conflates short-run stabilization with long-run fiscal sustainability, exposing members to deflationary and inflationary tail risks. We employ an estimated euro area model to analyze an alternative framework that separates these objectives. A centralized Treasury issues Eurobonds to finance countercyclical stabilization, while national governments retain responsibility for long-term fiscal sustainability. The Treasury can coordinate with the monetary authority in case of a large recession, with no need to suspend fiscal rules at the national level. The arrangement functions as an automatic stabilizer, eliminating the tail risks of deflation and fiscal stagflation.
abstract_zh: 当前欧元区政策框架将短期稳定与长期财政可持续性混为一谈，使成员国面临通缩与通胀尾部风险。我们采用欧元区估计模型分析一种分离上述目标的替代框架：由中央财政部发行欧洲债券为反周期稳定政策融资，而各国政府仍保留长期财政可持续性的责任。当遭遇严重衰退时，财政部可与货币当局协调行动，无需在国家层面暂停财政规则。该机制作为自动稳定器运行，消除了通缩与财政滞胀的尾部风险。

title: DP773 The Term Structure of Forward Exchange Premia and the Forecastability of Spot Exchange Rates: Correcting the Errors
title_zh: 远期升水期限结构与即期汇率可预测性：纠正误差
title_primary: 远期升水期限结构与即期汇率可预测性：纠正误差
title_secondary: DP773 The Term Structure of Forward Exchange Premia and the Forecastability of Spot Exchange Rates: Correcting the Errors
authors: Mark Taylor, Richard Clarida, Rasmus Lentz, Jonas Maibom, Espen Rasmus Moen 等
official: 官方在线 1993-06-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper challenges the widespread view that forward exchange premia contain little information regarding subsequent spot rate movements. Using weekly dollar/Deutschmark and dollar/sterling data, we show that spot and forward exchange rates are well represented by a vector error correction model and that the vector of forward premia form a basis for the cointegrating space. Dynamic forecasts indicate that the information in the forward premia can be used to reduce the root mean squared forecast error for the spot rate (relative to a random walk forecast) by at least 33% at a six-month horizon and by between 50% and 90% at a one-year horizon.
abstract_zh: 本文挑战了普遍认为远期升水对后续即期汇率变动几乎不包含信息的观点。基于美元/德国马克和美元/英镑的周度数据，我们证明即期汇率与远期汇率可由向量误差修正模型良好刻画，且远期升水向量构成协整空间的一组基。动态预测表明，远期升水中的信息可将即期汇率均方根预测误差（相对于随机游走预测）在六个月期至少降低33%，在一年期降低50%至90%。

title: Shaping forecast models for arbitrary choice of bandwidth
title_zh: 为任意带宽选择构建预测模型
title_primary: 为任意带宽选择构建预测模型
title_secondary: Shaping forecast models for arbitrary choice of bandwidth
authors: Ekaterina D. Smetanina, A. Timmermann, Yinchu Zhu
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Parameter instability has been widely documented to lead to poor predictive accuracy for economic forecasting models. Adaptive schemes for data weighting such as rolling-window estimation only involve a single tuning parameter (akin to a bandwidth) and are often used to address this issue. The importance of the shape of the weighting scheme (kernel) has received far less attention in the forecasting literature. In this paper we show that in practice there can be a large discrepancy between the theoretically optimal bias-variance tradeoff, based on the optimal bandwidth, and the actual bias-variance trade-off in practice, which depends jointly on the kernel shape as well as the (typically non-optimal) bandwidth. Simplifying this joint optimization problem by focusing only on one dimension, we show that optimizing over the kernel shape rather than the bandwidth often constitutes a better performing and more practical choice. We establish that a class of affine kernel shapes indexed by a single parameter, s, is optimal under squared forecast error loss, show that the shape parameter can be restricted to the interval [0, 2], where s = 0 corresponds to a uniform kernel (rolling-window) and s = 2 corresponds to a triangular kernel, and develop a robust three-point grid search method for choosing this shape parameter. An empirical analysis of U.S. inflation forecasting demonstrates the advantage of optimizing for the kernel shape parameter, particularly in unstable environments characterized by a time-varying bias-variance trade-off.
abstract_zh: 参数不稳定性已被广泛证实会导致经济预测模型的预测精度下降。诸如滚动窗口估计之类的自适应数据加权方案仅涉及单一调优参数（类似于带宽），常用于解决此问题。然而，在预测文献中，加权方案（核函数）形状的重要性受到的关注较少。本文表明，在实践中，基于最优带宽的理论最优偏差-方差权衡与实际中的偏差-方差权衡之间可能存在显著差异，后者同时依赖于核函数形状以及（通常非最优的）带宽。通过简化这一联合优化问题，仅聚焦于一个维度，我们证明，优化核函数形状而非带宽往往构成更优性能且更实用的选择。我们确立了一类由单一参数s索引的仿射核函数形状在平方预测误差损失下是最优的，表明形状参数可限制在区间[0, 2]内，其中s = 0对应均匀核（滚动窗口），s = 2对应三角核，并开发了一种稳健的三点网格搜索方法来选择此形状参数。对美国通胀预测的实证分析展示了优化核函数形状参数的优势，尤其是在以时变偏差-方差权衡为特征的不稳定环境中。

title: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
title_zh: GLP-1类药物对劳动力市场的影响
title_primary: GLP-1类药物对劳动力市场的影响
title_secondary: The Labor Market Impacts of GLP-1s
authors: Daysal, Meltem N., Fredrickson, Camille, Kristiansen, Ida Lykke, Trandafir, Mircea, Zhang, Jonathan 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate the causal impacts of GLP-1 treatment on labor market outcomes using linked Danish administrative data and a matched stacked difference-in-differences design. We compare patients who initiate GLP-1 treatment during the first two years of Semaglutide availability to observably similar patients who initiate four years later. We find that GLP-1 treatment reduces long-term sickness leave by 17.3%. We estimate total fiscal benefits of GLP-1 initiation of approximately 1.3–1.5% of annual labor income per employed individual. We do not detect statistically significant or economically meaningful impacts on income, labor force participation, or employment over four years.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦关联行政数据及匹配堆叠双重差分设计，评估了GLP-1治疗对劳动力市场结果的因果影响。我们将索马鲁肽上市前两年内开始GLP-1治疗的患者，与四年后开始治疗的观察特征相似的患者进行比较。研究发现，GLP-1治疗使长期病假减少了17.3%。我们估算，GLP-1治疗启动带来的总财政收益约为每位就业者年劳动收入的1.3%至1.5%。在四年期间，我们未检测到对收入、劳动力参与率或就业状况具有统计显著性或经济意义显著的影响。

title: The Anatomy of Censorship and Propaganda: Evidence from Russian Wikipedias
title_zh: 审查与宣传的剖析：来自俄语维基百科的证据
title_primary: 审查与宣传的剖析：来自俄语维基百科的证据
title_secondary: The Anatomy of Censorship and Propaganda: Evidence from Russian Wikipedias
authors: Ekaterina Zhuravskaya, Ulrich Matter, Ruben Durante, Vladimir Avetian
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Authoritarian regimes shape citizens’ knowledge and beliefs through censorship and propaganda. We study which narratives they suppress and promote using a rare natural experiment: Ruwiki, created in 2023 by cloning Russian-language Wikipedia and selectively rewriting its 1.9 million articles under regime-aligned editorial control. We compare the two platforms twenty months after the fork, using within-Wikipedia changes as a placebo benchmark. We find that Ruwiki’s editing patterns resemble professional rather than volunteer-driven content production. An LLM-based comparison and machine-learning analyses of text deletions and insertions reveal a coherent ideology organized around three pillars: Russia’s image vis-àvis the rest of the world, domestic politics, and culture. The resulting narratives legitimize Russia’s past and present acts of aggression, suppress accounts of domestic opposition and human-rights violations, and promote traditional values. Culture’s centrality reveals how authoritarian information control penetrates domains far beyond formal politics, including morality, gender, family life, law, and psychology. Article deletions are rare and confined to topics that are difficult to reframe, while editing is broad, consistent with a preference for reframing existing content rather than leaving unanswered queries: 27% of articles undergo at least some change, 2.8% are heavily edited, and only 0.14% are deleted. Rewriting sensitive topics reduces readability, suggesting that ideological control is costly. An external benchmark using official high-school history textbooks confirms that Ruwiki’s revisions move articles on modern history toward state-sanctioned narratives. The results show how authoritarian information control constructs a regime-aligned account of the world and Russia’s place in it.
abstract_zh: 威权政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的知识与信念。我们利用一项罕见的自然实验——Ruwiki（2023年通过克隆俄语维基百科并在亲政权编辑控制下选择性重写其190万篇文章创建而成）——研究其压制和推广的叙事。在分叉二十个月后，我们以维基百科内部变化作为安慰剂基准，对两个平台进行比较。研究发现，Ruwiki的编辑模式更接近专业内容生产而非志愿者驱动。基于大语言模型的比较以及对文本删除和插入的机器学习分析揭示了一套围绕三大支柱构建的连贯意识形态：俄罗斯相对于世界其他地区的形象、国内政治以及文化。由此产生的叙事将俄罗斯过去和现在的侵略行为合法化，压制国内反对派和人权侵犯的报道，并推广传统价值观。文化的核心地位揭示了威权信息控制如何渗透到远超正式政治领域的范畴，包括道德、性别、家庭生活、法律和心理学。文章删除极为罕见，仅限于难以重新框架化的主题；而编辑则广泛存在，这与偏好重新框架现有内容而非留下未解答疑问的倾向一致：27%的文章经历了至少某种程度的修改，2.8%被大幅编辑，仅0.14%被删除。对敏感话题的重写降低了可读性，表明意识形态控制代价高昂。使用官方高中历史教科书作为外部基准证实，Ruwiki的修订将现代史相关文章推向国家认可的叙事。研究结果展示了威权信息控制如何构建一套符合政权立场的世界叙事及俄罗斯在其中地位的图景。

abstract: Employing large language models to analyze official documents, we construct a comprehensive record of daily changes in de jure restrictions on cross-border flows worldwide since the 1950s. Our analysis uncovers the wide array of instruments used to regulate cross-border financial flows over the past seven decades, leveraging the fine granularity of the new measures to characterize cross-country and time-series variation across eight categories of restrictions —- distinguishing by flow, direction, instrument type, intensity, and overall policy stance. We exploit the high frequency nature of the new data to document novel patterns in the use of these restrictions, as well as their relationship to crises and political economy determinants.
abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型分析官方文件，我们构建了自20世纪50年代以来全球跨境流动法律限制每日变化的综合记录。通过新措施的高粒度特性，我们揭示了过去七十年间用于监管跨境资金流动的广泛工具组合，从八个限制类别（按流动类型、方向、工具种类、强度及整体政策立场区分）刻画了跨国与时间序列的差异。借助新数据的高频特征，我们记录了这些限制使用的新模式，及其与危机和政治经济决定因素之间的关联。

title: Labor market competition and inequality
title_zh: 劳动力市场竞争与不平等
title_primary: 劳动力市场竞争与不平等
title_secondary: Labor market competition and inequality
authors: Jose Garcia-Louzao, Alessandro Ruggieri
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We exploit a novel opportunity to study the dynamics of wage inequality and labor market competition over the course of economic development. Our context is Lithuania, where two decades of sustained growth and labor market tightening coincided with a substantial decline in wage inequality. We first fit a two-way fixed-effects model with worker and firm heterogeneity and document that the compression of the variance of firm fixed effects has been the main source of the fall in inequality. Guided by a standard dynamic monopsony model, we then estimate firms’ labor supply elasticities and show that labor market competition has increased over the same period. Finally, we construct a shift-share instrument and provide evidence that new job opportunities created by the accession to the European Union in 2004 contributed to the fall in inequality through their impact on labor market competition in Lithuania.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个新颖的研究机会，探讨经济发展过程中工资不平等与劳动力市场竞争的动态变化。我们的研究背景是立陶宛，该国在经历了二十年的持续增长和劳动力市场紧缩的同时，工资不平等显著下降。我们首先拟合了一个包含工人和企业异质性的双向固定效应模型，并记录到企业固定效应方差的压缩是导致不平等下降的主要因素。在标准动态买方垄断模型的指导下，我们随后估计了企业的劳动力供给弹性，并显示在同一时期内劳动力市场竞争有所增强。最后，我们构建了一个转移份额工具，并提供证据表明，2004年加入欧盟所创造的新就业机会，通过其对立陶宛劳动力市场竞争的影响，促进了不平等的下降。

authors: Patrick A. Imam, Jonathan R. W. Temple
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Recent work suggests that cross-country convergence has strengthened over time. Here we explore mobility and convergence in relative income and relative total factor productivity (TFP) using finite state Markov chains. We find that low-income countries rarely improve their position relative to the US. Since capital-output ratios have approached or exceeded the US level and human capital is converging, the persistence of low relative income seems to originate in low relative TFP. We study the dynamics of relative TFP, how they have changed, and how they interact with absolute levels of human capital, casting new light on the future of convergence.
abstract_zh: 近期研究指出，跨国间的经济趋同现象随时间推移有所增强。本文利用有限状态马尔可夫链，探讨了相对收入与相对全要素生产率（TFP）中的流动性与趋同趋势。研究发现，低收入国家相对于美国的位置鲜有改善。鉴于资本产出比已接近或超越美国水平，且人力资本正趋于一致，低收入国家相对收入持续低迷的根源似乎在于相对TFP的低下。我们进一步分析了相对TFP的动态变化、其演变方式及其与人力资本绝对水平的相互作用，为未来趋同前景提供了新的视角。

authors: Vasiliki Fouka, Theo Serlin
official: 官方在线 2026-01-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When do people identify with their class? Evidence from social psychology shows that individuals are more likely to identify with a group if they are similar to its members. We study early 20th century Britain and show that regional cultural heterogeneity combined with internal migration influenced class identity. We develop and validate a measure of class identity using naming decisions. Exploiting within-household variation, we show that migration patterns that increased the local share of culturally-distant workers reduced working class identification. Where migration increased the cultural distance of the working class, workers were less likely to join unions, voters were less likely to support the nascent Labour Party, and parliamentary candidates were less likely to target working class voters. By 1911, slower in-migration and rising local population growth reduced working class distance in urban areas, which also became strongholds of support for Labour. Migration alters social identity and creates political cleavages.
abstract_zh: 人们何时会认同自己的阶级？社会心理学证据表明，个体与群体成员相似度越高，越可能产生群体认同。本研究以20世纪初的英国为对象，揭示区域文化异质性与内部迁移共同塑造了阶级认同。我们通过命名决策开发并验证了阶级认同的测量指标。利用家庭内部差异分析发现，增加本地文化疏离型工人比例的迁移模式会削弱工人阶级认同。当迁移加剧工人阶级文化距离时，工人加入工会的意愿降低，选民对新兴工党的支持率下降，议会候选人针对工人阶级选民的竞选策略也相应减少。至1911年，缓慢的迁入增长与本地人口上升缩小了城市地区的工人阶级文化距离，这些区域随之成为工党票仓。迁移重塑社会认同，并催生政治分野。

title: Product Positioning and Incentives to Innovate
title_zh: 产品定位与创新激励
title_primary: 产品定位与创新激励
title_secondary: Product Positioning and Incentives to Innovate
authors: Emanuele Bacchiega, Paolo G. Garella
official: 官方在线 2025-10-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper shows that product positioning affects the incentives to invest in process innovation. The result is found using a model of price competition with three firms under horizontal product differentiation—and then extended to a more general Bertrand triopoly. The central firm may have a higher gain from a cost reduction than the peripheral firms, even if it reaps a lower profit or has a lower demand. By contrast, the peripheral firms have a larger gain if, and only if, they also have larger profits. Furthermore, we argue that the central firm exploits a reduction in the marginal cost mainly to expand its sales, whereas the peripheral ones to increase their markup. We finally show that the aggregate innovation incentives are larger the more clustered toward the center are the firms and the larger the preinnovation cost asymmetry. We also analyze the effects of mergers on innovation incentives, confirming that they tend to reduce the merged firms' incentives to innovate.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，产品定位影响工艺创新的投资激励。这一结论通过一个包含三家企业、水平产品差异化的价格竞争模型得出，并进一步扩展至更一般的伯特兰三头垄断情形。中心企业可能从成本降低中获得比外围企业更高的收益，即便其利润较低或需求较小。相反，外围企业只有在利润也更高时，其收益才会更大。此外，我们认为中心企业主要利用边际成本的降低来扩大销售，而外围企业则旨在提高其加成率。最后，我们证明，企业越向中心聚集，且创新前成本不对称性越大，总体创新激励越强。我们还分析了并购对创新激励的影响，确认并购往往降低合并企业的创新激励。

official: 官方在线 2025-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study explores the relationship between negative online word-of-mouth (NeWOM) on social media and corporate cash holdings. Utilizing data from Fortune 500 firms spanning the years 2010 to 2017, our analysis reveals a positive association between negative online word-of-mouth and the cash-holding policies of these firms. By analysing the moderating factors, we find that high litigation risk and greater diversification weaken the positive relation between NeWOM and cash holding. Conversely, a higher level of insider shareholding enhances the relation between NeWOM and cash holding. Our findings remain robust across econometric specifications, controlling for endogeneity and alternative measures of proxies. Overall, this study contributes by introducing a previously unexplored determinant of cash holdings and providing valuable insights into the ongoing global discourse on the opportunities and implications of social media for corporations.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了社交媒体上的负面在线口碑（NeWOM）与企业现金持有之间的关系。利用2010年至2017年间《财富》500强企业的数据，我们的分析揭示了负面在线口碑与这些企业现金持有政策之间存在正相关关系。通过分析调节因素，我们发现高诉讼风险和更大的多元化程度会削弱NeWOM与现金持有之间的正相关关系。相反，内部人持股比例较高则会增强NeWOM与现金持有之间的关系。我们的研究结果在各种计量经济学设定下均保持稳健，包括控制内生性和替代代理变量的情况。总体而言，本研究通过引入一个先前未被探索的现金持有决定因素，并为当前关于社交媒体为企业带来的机遇与影响的全球讨论提供了有价值的见解。
